definitions.explanation: The movable fold of skin that covers and protects the eye.

examples.japanese: {瞼|まぶた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重|おも}く→重い：00804_omoi⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦きた→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
{瞼|まぶた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{閉|と}じて→閉じる：02303_tojiru⟧⟦{深呼吸|しんこきゅう}した→深呼吸：13294_shinkokyuu⟧。
examples.english: I closed my eyes and took a deep breath.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一重|ひとえ}→一重：06463_hitoe⟧{瞼|まぶた}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{二重|ふたえ}→二重：06464_futae⟧{瞼|まぶた}、⟦どちら→どちら：00927_dochira⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}きですか→好き：02355_suki⟧。
examples.english: Which do you prefer, single or double eyelids?

examples.japanese: ⟦{花粉症|かふんしょう}→花粉症：04409_kafunshou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{瞼|まぶた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{腫|は}れて→腫れる：12325_hareru⟧⟦しまった→しまう：03064_shimau⟧。
examples.english: My eyelids swelled up because of hay fever.

examples.japanese: ⟦{疲|つか}れて→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧{瞼|まぶた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重|おも}く→重い：00804_omoi⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧、⟦{気|き}がつくと→気がつく：21794_kigatsuku⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}っていた→眠る：01181_nemuru⟧。
examples.english: My eyelids grew heavy from tiredness, and before I knew it I had fallen asleep on the train.

notes:
{瞼|まぶた} (eyelid) is commonly written in hiragana as まぶた.

WRITING:
The kanji {瞼|まぶた} is complex and often replaced with hiragana.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {瞼|まぶた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重|おも}い→重い：00804_omoi⟧ (eyelids are heavy - sleepy)
- {瞼|まぶた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{閉|と}じる→閉じる：02303_tojiru⟧ (close one's eyes)
- {瞼|まぶた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧ (open one's eyes)
- ⟦{一重|ひとえ}→一重：06463_hitoe⟧{瞼|まぶた} (single eyelid - monolid)
- ⟦{二重|ふたえ}→二重：06464_futae⟧{瞼|まぶた} (double eyelid)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, ⟦{一重|ひとえ}→一重：06463_hitoe⟧ (single eyelid) vs ⟦{二重|ふたえ}→二重：06464_futae⟧ (double eyelid) is a common topic in beauty discussions. Some people use tape or glue to create a double-eyelid crease.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
{瞼|まぶた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{浮|う}かぶ→浮かぶ：03916_ukabu⟧ = to come to mind, to visualize (literally: to float before one's eyelids)
